c.st: Ask HN: Does this math education idea make sense?

For a more traditional, formal approach, Saracino's "Abstract Algebra: A First Course" is my favorite among this genre.

I have also heard good things about Pinter's "A Book of Abstract Algebra", and it is available quite cheaply. I have not read it though.

Good luck!
